worldcombat.skill.naturalgift.summary: Crush the held Berry and strike with its element; the damage type and power come from that Berry, which is consumed on use.
worldcombat.skill.naturalgift.use.1: Turn a spare Berry into one typed hit
worldcombat.skill.naturalgift.descriptio: Crushes the held Berry and deals %1$s physical damage of the Berry's type, consuming the Berry.
After %1$s s of chewing, step up to %2$s blocks to strike; savoring is slower but stronger.
worldcombat.skill.naturalgift.timing: Windup %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.naturalgift.preference: On: chew 0.4 s longer for x1.3 damage, good against one tough target; Off: strike at once for the Berry's base power, good for a quick hit. Both directions trade speed for power.
Only attack within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
When on, a stationed companion leaves its post to take this bite; when off it stays put.
